title: SysMon
summary: System monitor: CPU, processes, network speed, battery, level and sound meter
description:
SysMon shows what your CardputerZero is doing, across six pages.

Overview: CPU with a 60-second graph, per-core load, RAM, temperature and battery.
Processes: the top 5 by CPU or memory; end one from the keyboard.
Network: interfaces, Wi-Fi signal and a live download/upload speed graph.
Power: 4-minute temperature history, battery time-left / time-to-full estimate, disk and uptime.
Level: a bubble level from the built-in motion sensor.
Sound: a live microphone loudness meter with one-key quiet calibration.

Left/Right or Tab switch pages, 1-6 jump, ESC quits. The microphone is only used while the Sound page is open, and nothing is recorded.

Source and docs: https://github.com/duanesweazy1/pocket-sysmon
